sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops Mixpanel, Adjust, and Firebase/Google Analytics.
Removes the Ask Perplexity AI button from Discover.
Keeps the app from requiring a newer version before it opens.
Stops the Play Store update and rating prompts.
Shows a post's picture as a picture when the app would draw it as a video that cannot play.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hides the Truth+ button, the Watch tab, the Truth+ live shows row, and the Truth+ banners.
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Lets the Save button save videos too, and names it "Save video" for a video.
Shows each option's share of the votes before you vote. You can still vote.
Shows media in posts marked sensitive without blurring it first.
Removes the sponsored and boosted posts and the other ads from the feeds.
